Let  
\[
a=\cos\frac{2\pi}{7},\quad b=\cos\frac{4\pi}{7},\quad c=\cos\frac{6\pi}{7}.
\]
These are roots of
\[
8x^3+4x^2-4x-1=0.
\]
By Vieta’s formulas,
\[
a+b+c=-\frac12,\qquad ab+bc+ca=-\frac12,\qquad abc=\frac18.
\]
Thus
\[
\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c
=\frac{ab+bc+ca}{abc}
=\frac{-\frac12}{\frac18}
=-4.
\]
Therefore the original sum is
\[
\frac12\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right)
=\frac12(-4)
=-2.
\]

\[
\boxed{-2}
\]
